slices.title: Freeze catalogue source inventory
slices.summary: Frozen the pre-change catalogue source map. The baseline distinguishes 33 concrete assets and 10 lazy packs from 50 descriptors, 34 Workbench identities, 41 display rows, 69 Workbench relationships, and 82 display representations. It records concrete identity/loading, mixed projection, adapter, route, and review-capture ownership; preserves all existing routes; and fixes the next boundary at one row per concrete loadable ID without changing runtime or visual behavior. Focused 21/21, full 3130/3130, typecheck, build, promotion memory, diff hygiene, and workspace validation pass.

slices.title: Characterize loadable asset registry
slices.summary: Added a compact typed loadable registry that groups the generated editor metadata by concrete animation ID, requires one exact asset-level descriptor, records one lazy pack owner, and carries no renderer, representation, lifecycle, or roadmap state. Characterization proves one entry for each of the 33 concrete assets, successful resolution across all 10 packs, and exclusion of seven reader-only playable display IDs plus the planned quadratic identity. Eight focused tests, full typecheck, architecture, diff hygiene, and workspace validation pass; no runtime consumer or visual behavior changed.
